name: Dev Console
description: The Dev Console's settings interface, shared: every app that ships it shows its settings page the same way, and a pick in one app follows to the others through axHub. Simple / Basic / Developer / Administrator levels (Oct 28 2026; Administrator shows all): Simple has the Sliders section. Compact (Oct 30 2026): a short list of sections you tap into (list + page side by side on wide screens), sections with many sub-pages list them as rows, flat hairline groups, one-line rows, dropdowns.
author: AmberX AXF
